notes: Each analog sensor is drawn as an FSR (the manual allows potentiometers/photocells too); the FSR's two bent legs (blue and red) plug directly into the breadboard, so no extra wires are modelled for them.
Each divider: FSR from +5V rail to a node column; 10k resistor from that node column to the GND rail; yellow wire from the node column to A0/A1/A2 (matches schematic).

The image labels the lower half of the breadboard rows a-e; the catalogue names the lower bank 'b' with rows f-j, so image row e/d/c/b/a maps to f/g/h/i/j. Yellow wires land on row f, the FSR leg on row i and the resistor on row j of the same column strip.
Rail hole indices (tp.1, tn.2, tp.30, tn.29, bp.4/12/22, bn.6/16/24, bn.29, bp.30) are estimated from the image; every rail is a single strip so exact index is not electrically significant.
Top-half rail polarity: red + line is 'tp', black/- line is 'tn'; the right-hand black and red wires at the end of the breadboard carry GND and 5V down to the lower rails.
The Processing / Max software and the USB connection to the computer are not part of the build graph.
